ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels and 25% low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the margins and in linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black region on the far-left lateral margin. Multiple discrete, high-contrast circular black spots located on the medial-right lobe. Sparse low-intensity mottling along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped median notch with an estimated interior pixel angle of 35 degrees and a deep vertical-axis penetration relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency serration pattern with irregular pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks and valleys) along the entire span of both the left and right trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp, tapered convex sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, roughly circular high-contrast clusters indicative of calcium-carbonate biological growth on the far-lateral tips of both lobes. Two distinct circular dark focal points in the upper-mid region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the center of both the left and right lobes, with a prominent deep-black diagonal line on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across 40% of the visible ventral surface and significant biological encrustation on the apical margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged edge loss on the right lobe trailing edge, creating a saw-tooth silhouette against the background.
